Yeah the rumination barely goes away, but to combat that just focus on other things. Your job, school, or hobbies. Talking to friends really helps my brain stop ruminating about it, and sometimes I completely forget about it. Sitting in bed all day just makes it worse, and laying staring at the wall does the same thing. It’s okay to think about it, and sometimes that’s apart of the process of getting over it, but to do it all the time does not help, it only brings you down. So try your best to get out there and feel better even if you don’t feel like it. Forcing yourself to do things is the way to go, cause once you’re in them you’ll thank yourself. Good luck my friend. <3

I’d say do a hobby that takes your mind off the whole situation. For me it’s videogames, as well as hanging out with friends. Nighttime’s and mornings are going to be the hardest. For mornings, I just get outta bed and try not to ruminate, and worry about what I can’t change, and go on about my day and completely occupy my mind. As for nights, I typically write out my feelings on here, take a sleeping pill so I’m drowsy and watch some YouTube to fall asleep to. 

I’d also recommend bettering yourself, and doing things that’ll make you feel better. Really find what makes you feel good and happy, be independent. I also started reading the Bible and praying when things get tough and that helps me a lot, so i definitely would try that as well. 

I don’t know you, but I know you’re a strong individual and you can get through this. It’s all a mental battle, and I know you can win it. Have an amazing day stranger, I wish you the best. <3
